name: Grit
description: +1.5 max HP and reduces monster damage taken.

name: Endurance
description: +1.5 max Stamina and +0.5% Stamina regeneration per point.

name: Willpower
description: +1.5 max Mana and +0.75 max HP per point.

name: Spirit
description: +0.5% Mana regeneration per point, and reduces monster damage taken (half as much as Grit).

name: Fortune
description: More gear drops (diminishing, up to +50% drop chance) and +2% Focus from kills per point.

name: Speed
description: Fills your ability cooldowns faster — more attacks per minute, as long as Stamina and Mana keep up.

name: Precision
description: Crit Chance (diminishing, up to +40%) and +0.3% Crit Damage per point.
